deferred.name: Product Onboarding
deferred.insertion: First-run flow reuses provider/account/installation records; no duplicate secret store.
deferred.return_contract: Completed setup returns to the Providers manager with the new connection selected and a continuation receipt.

deferred.name: Installation / Deployment
deferred.insertion: Explicit user-triggered install from the official source for the exact Host/Environment.
deferred.return_contract: Install receipts deep-link back to the provider installation section; failed verification returns with previous generation restored.

deferred.name: Server Claim / Bootstrap
deferred.insertion: Claim handshake binds a server record to this install before hosted work is offered.
deferred.return_contract: Successful claim returns to the Servers card with the server marked connected and a claim receipt.

deferred.name: Servers / Execution Hosts / Clients
deferred.insertion: Manager grammar reserved under System & Advanced; human-language cards only.
deferred.return_contract: Server cards deep-link back into Settings at the matching storage or hosting row.

deferred.name: Project Hosting & Files
deferred.insertion: Source Location card (Hosted On, Project Files, Run Work) plus sync status slots.
deferred.return_contract: Hosting changes return to the Project Hosting card with sync status and a move receipt.

deferred.name: Remote Access
deferred.insertion: Pairing and session approvals; protected auth browsing stays human-only.
deferred.return_contract: Approvals return to the Remote Access card with the session list updated.

deferred.name: Project Sync / Move
deferred.insertion: Project relocation and sync bundles owned by the sync pipeline.
deferred.return_contract: A finished move returns to Settings Lifecycle with settings re-verified and conflicts queued.

deferred.name: Puppet Master application/content updates
deferred.insertion: Host-scoped signed Puppet Master updates, separate from provider/LSP/container updates.
deferred.return_contract: Update status cards deep-link into the Updates manager with signed-build receipts.

deferred.name: Full Server backup owner flow
deferred.insertion: Full Server backup class with its own schedule and verification.
deferred.return_contract: Backup runs return to the Backup manager's server class with verification receipts.
